creative_aplus_render_20261031.verdict: A+ content is now rendered and measured, not described. Product packages gain a legibility gate on the composited label.
creative_aplus_render_20261031.gap_found: aplus_layout owned the geometry and nothing owned the pixels: creative_flow.step_aplus wrote aplus_specs.json and set valid=true, so A+ 'content' in the product was a rectangle map. Second finding: specialists.image_aplus.validate_module_image compared a 970-wide tile ROW against MODULES' 300px TILE and did not know 'comparison', so every correct row asset was rejected. Two subsystems that had never been introduced to each other.

built.aplus_render.py: Deterministic offline renderer for all 11 module kinds, drawing only into aplus_layout.pixel_plan() rects. Type composited, never generated. copy_style='panel' (default) reserves a brand-field column so type cannot land on the plate's own printing; 'overlay' sets type on the image behind a scrim raised until MEASURED contrast passes, gated by a backdrop-variance ceiling (0.06). The scrim colour is chosen to stand off the ink (a dark-ink plate gets a light veil, never a further darkening). A brand accent used for small caps is darkened toward ink until it passes; keylines and icons keep the true accent. Prohibited A+ copy is refused before a pixel is written via specialists.image_aplus.screen_copy.
built.qa: canvas exactness, per-block containment, WCAG worst-LOCAL-CELL contrast (4.5 body / 3.0 large), 14px type floor, no clipping (a block that will not fit is reported, never truncated silently), 2 MB ceiling, plate sharpness (refuse a blow-up past 2x). assert_perfect() raises AplusNotPerfect with the named defects.
built.design_studio_aplus.py: GET /api/design-studio/aplus/kinds and POST /api/design-studio/aplus/render (renders from a saved plate asset, registers each module as asset_type=aplus_module plus a page preview, returns per-module QA; prohibited copy -> 422 before any write). Mounted in main.py and verified through the app: kinds -> 200 OK, 11 kinds.
built.creative_flow_step_aplus: now renders the page from 01_plate.png with the job's brand and copy (flow keys title/subtitle mapped to headline/sub), writes <out>/aplus/, and records upload_ready plus defects. A defect is surfaced, NOT a code rollback - state.status stays ok.
built.creative_flow_face_legibility: crops the measured quad (+8px), upsamples 2x and runs the same OCR gate the listing lane uses; compose records 'label_illegible'. No quad -> skipped, no OCR -> unavailable. It never invents a verdict.

creative_aplus_render_20261031.not_done: No A+ module builder in the Design Studio SPA (the API exists and is mounted) - that is the next unit. Tile rows reuse one plate unless tile_asset_ids are supplied (warned, not hidden). Package legibility depends on OCR at render size: on a 1216px plate fine print is beyond it and the gate reports 'unavailable' rather than a false pass. A+ is screen media, so no 300 DPI gate applies - print_prep stays the authority for anything going to a co-packer.
